notes.title: Monster Ops Episode 9 is LIVE NOW!
notes.notes:
You can play Monster Ops Episode 1 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3004790/Monster_Ops/?snr=1_5_9_]free here[/url], get episodes 2-6 in a [url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/53558/Monster_Ops_Episodes_16/]bundle here[/url], and now [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3414770/Monster_Ops_9/]Episode 9 is live![/url] (The next bundle will be episodes 7-12 in November 2025).

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/35059450/55dd3ce81b00c43701dd73e20887ba4bd148c1b4.png[/img]

Things get ever more dicey for Wraith and Tide.  Not only are dangerous monsters being recruited, a whole cult has been brought to Site 6 to be turned into monsters--and they worship Balasque?!

Neither Wraith nor Tide know what Major Denise is planning, but they fear that following orders blindly will get them accused of war crimes one day.  It's time to do some digging to figure out who Denise really is!

Unfortunately, Balasque has decided to betray Tide's trust in the most insidious way possible...and has sworn Tide to secrecy!

And remember, beta Patrons are on episode 14 this month! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/KyhMvJg]Discord[/url] or visit our [url=https://ypressgames.com/]web site[/url] to learn how to get episodes 6 months early!
